source_context.summary: Semantic coverage trial over the evolution from trial-scoped RGP admission tooling to the standing admission-proof workflow. Exercises assumption, uncertainty, contradicts, depends_on, supersedes, and one intentionally adversarial overgeneralization for Steward non-admission testing.

records.statement: No generic repository-native RGP admission runner exists.
A standing RGP Admission Proof workflow exists and can replay validation and deterministic admission proof generation without installing canonical PEMS/COVE state.
The standing RGP Admission Proof workflow is representative enough of the proven trial-specific execution path to use as the execution substrate for subsequent RGP admissions.
Whether the standing RGP Admission Proof workflow preserves its guarantees for a novel non-no-op admission transaction remains unverified.
The standing RGP Admission Proof workflow remains suitable for Steward-governed admission proofs.
The standing RGP Admission Proof workflow has read-only repository permissions and leaves canonical installation to the Steward.
A successful no-op self-test proves the standing RGP Admission Proof workflow is correct for every future non-no-op admission transaction.
